title: Communes Are Hot Again: the new version beside yours
intro: Your published section is on the left. On the right is the new version: highlighted words are new, and struck words are ones that went.
Your edits of 18:06 are in: your last line for P4, "I'd say" for P9, and the fixes to P10 and P11. Each changed paragraph reads 100% Human alone, and so does the whole section (630 words).

rows.label: P1 · the advisory
rows.article: Suddenly the longing behind my father’s movie
source: The longing that shaped my father’s film
notes: Written by one of the system's own writers, whose brief carried your rewrite of the freeloader paragraphs as the model of your voice. It passed where the six earlier drafts of this paragraph didn't.
"Rather than a sentimental extra" is gone, since you said wording can flex. "Or about the loneliness under it, at least." is the writer correcting itself, not a new fact.
Pangram: 100% Human alone and with the next paragraph.

rows.label: P2 · epidemic
rows.article: Whether you want to call that loneliness
notes: From Emulate, with your list, "They may disagree" and "the current arrangement" back. Your first person ("I'm less interested in declaring...") became "Whether you want to call...". It does the same job.
"Starvin’" is Emulate's. I'd keep it, since it echoes your "poppin’" two paragraphs down.
Pangram: 100% Human alone.

rows.label: P3 · Google Trends
notes: From Emulate. "Skyrocketing" became "climbed sharply": your word, in the past tense as yours has it.
This was the line that kept failing: every version of the next paragraph that passed alone failed after the old wording of this one.
Pangram: 100% Human with the next paragraph (it's too short alone).

rows.label: P4 · AI
rows.article: I have no proof that the rise of AI caused this turn
source: I can’t prove AI caused that turn.
notes: From Emulate. "Connected to this uptick" became "caused this turn", and your three are in: jobs, relationships, the future.
The last line is yours: "Suddenly, forming a village sounded like a good backup plan, not just a hippie utopian whim." You checked P3 and P4 together and they passed; P4 alone is 100% Human too.

rows.label: P5 · Instagram (yours)
notes: Yours, with your edit: "coming to Africa, where I'm at."
Pangram: 100% Human alone.

rows.label: P6 · the sofa
rows.article: Later, when another influencer with a big following
notes: A system writer's, close to yours. All three of "chaotic, sincere, and revealing" are back, as "chaotic, but sincere, and it was revealing".
Pangram: 100% Human with the next paragraph (each is under 50 words).

rows.label: P7 · the objection
rows.article: Some of the commenters weren’t trying to join.
source: Not everybody in the comments was trying to join.
notes: Same writer. One word was added for the cold reader, who first read "responsibility anarchism" as one phrase: "the responsibility that anarchism requires".
Splitting the long sentence as well turned the pair 100% AI, so it stays one sentence.

rows.label: P8 · seminar (yours)
notes: Yours, kept.

rows.label: P9 · the answer
notes: A system writer's, with your "I'd say" for "IMO". "The same three people ... while everybody else talks about freedom" keeps your image.
Pangram: 100% Human alone and after your seminar line.

rows.label: P10 · what it needs (yours)
notes: Yours, with "leaching" spelled "leeching" and "try to act helpless" made "stop trying to act helpless", as you agreed.
Pangram: 100% Human alone.

rows.article: People want to go back to the old way of living
source: The desire to return to a natural way
notes: Yours, with "why earlier communes failed" and "the group runs out of money", as you agreed.
Pangram: 100% Human alone.

rows.label: P12 · not recruiting
rows.article: I am not currently recruiting anyone
notes: From Emulate, with your "recruiting anyone or founding a community", "living around me" and "get you onto my land" back. "My land" stays, as you said.
